summary: Tested all 5 new lead management rules. All backend APIs (22/22 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Rule 1 (Assignment Enforcement): Correctly blocks unassigned leads from moving to interested/not_answered/followup statuses
Rule 2 (Closed Reason Required): Properly requires closed_reason when changing to lost/not_interested, returns available_reasons in error response
Rule 3 (Duplicate Detection): check-duplicate endpoint works, 409 returned for duplicates, force_create bypasses check
Rule 4 (Notifications): API endpoints working for get/mark-read/mark-all-read
Rule 5 (Stage Transition): Correctly blocks interested/followup -> not_interested, allows interested -> won/lost
Frontend: Duplicate warning shows in Create Lead dialog, Closed Reason dialog appears when needed, Rule 5 toast notification works
seed_data_creation: Test leads created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 lead management rules fully implemented and tested. Backend validation working for all rules. Frontend has duplicate detection in Create Lead dialog, closed reason dialog in Lead Detail page, and toast notifications for blocked transitions.
